verdict.rationale: Bento is an observability platform rather than an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. The only MCP evidence is that coding agents install Bento's skill and then "load the docs over MCP," which points to an official docs-serving MCP endpoint, not one exposing product data or actions. Product operations such as triaging issues, reading runs and managing signals are documented only via the CLI. missing for 10: documented MCP server exposing Bento product data and actions (traces, issues, signals), MCP server setup and connection docs, tool list, independent or hands-on corroboration
